definitions.explanation: The administrative office of a town ({町|まち}). Handles resident registration, tax collection, permits, and other local government services. Equivalent to a city hall but for smaller municipalities classified as {町|まち}.

examples.japanese: {町役場|まちやくば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{届|とど}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I submitted the notification at the town hall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{町役場|まちやくば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can process your move-in registration at the town hall counter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{町役場|まちやくば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}して→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧、⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧になった。
examples.english: The new town hall building was completed in front of the station, making things more convenient for residents.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for municipalities classified as ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧. Larger municipalities classified as ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ use ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧ (city hall), while villages use ⟦{村役場|むらやくば}→村役場：24018_murayakuba⟧ (village office). In Japanese administrative structure, ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧ falls between ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ (city) and ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧ (village).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町役場|まちやくば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: town hall counter
- {町役場|まちやくば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{届|とど}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: file a notification at the town hall
- {町役場|まちやくば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧: town hall staff
